title: Control blocks
subtitle: Stateful loops between rules and devices — filters, thermostats, sequencers. Each block is a virtual device you can chart, wire and command.

errors.load: Failed to load control blocks. Check ApiGateway / AutomationService connection.

confirmDelete: Delete block "{{name}}"? Its virtual device disappears.
empty: No control loops yet — press “Add block” and I will keep it running.

ewma_filter.title: EWMA filter
ewma_filter.desc: Exponentially-weighted moving average — smooths a noisy numeric signal.

thermostat.title: Thermostat (hysteresis)
thermostat.desc: Bang-bang heating/cooling demand from a temperature input and a setpoint, with hysteresis.

co2_ventilation.title: CO₂ ventilation
co2_ventilation.desc: Demands ventilation when CO₂ rises above a threshold (with hysteresis).

irrigation_sequencer.title: Irrigation cycle
irrigation_sequencer.desc: Opens a valve for a run time on a fixed interval; an inhibit input (rain) skips a cycle.

sun_gate.title: Sun gate (outdoor lighting)
sun_gate.desc: On while it is dark at the site (dusk-to-dawn), with a lead/trail offset — for outdoor lights.

ml_setpoint.title: ML setpoint (learned schedule)
ml_setpoint.desc: Emits a temperature setpoint predicted by the learned schedule model.

ml_predictor.title: ML predictor (source)
ml_predictor.desc: Emits a trained model's prediction for a target as a numeric signal for other blocks.

ml_thermostat.title: ML thermostat (setpoint governor)
ml_thermostat.desc: Proposes a learned temperature setpoint to a deterministic thermostat loop, staged Shadow → Bounded → Full under the safety floor.

ml_switch.title: ML switch (on/off governor)
ml_switch.desc: Proposes a learned on/off schedule to a deterministic switch, staged Shadow → Bounded → Full with a probability threshold + anti-chatter dwell. Use when the trained target is a boolean capability.

ml_selector.title: ML mode selector
ml_selector.desc: Proposes a learned enum schedule (e.g. an HVAC mode) to a deterministic loop, staged Shadow → Bounded → Full, Bounded limited to adjacent values. Use when the trained target is an enum capability.

comparator.title: Comparator
comparator.desc: Emits true when the input satisfies an operator against a threshold.

hysteresis.title: Hysteresis (relay)
hysteresis.desc: Two-threshold on/off with a dead-band — the generic bang-bang controller.

window.title: Window (in-range)
window.desc: True while the input is between low and high (or outside, when inverted).

logic.title: Logic gate
logic.desc: Combines boolean inputs with and/or/xor/nand/nor (+ optional invert).

select.title: Select (2:1)
select.desc: Outputs a when sel is true, otherwise b.

clamp.title: Clamp (limiter)
clamp.desc: Constrains the input to a [min, max] range.

deadband.title: Deadband
deadband.desc: Holds the output until the input changes by at least epsilon.

rate_limiter.title: Rate limiter (slew)
rate_limiter.desc: Caps the output's rate of change toward the input.

aggregate.title: Aggregate
aggregate.desc: Combines several numeric inputs with min/max/sum/avg.

min_dwell.title: Minimum dwell (anti-chatter)
min_dwell.desc: Holds a boolean for a minimum time before it may change again.

pid.title: PID controller
pid.desc: Continuous 0–100 % control of a device by power/position, with optional feedforward.

on_delay.title: On-delay (TON)
on_delay.desc: Passes true only after the input has been true continuously for a delay.

off_delay.title: Off-delay (TOFF)
off_delay.desc: Holds the output true for a delay after the input goes false.

pulse.title: Pulse (one-shot)
pulse.desc: Emits a fixed-width true pulse on each rising edge of the trigger.

interval.title: Interval timer
interval.desc: True for a run-window at the start of every period (optionally gated by enable).

edge.title: Edge detector
edge.desc: Momentary true when the input changes (rising/falling/both).

latch.title: Latch (SR)
latch.desc: Holds true after set, false after reset; priority breaks a tie.

counter.title: Counter
counter.desc: Counts rising edges of the increment input; reset zeroes the count.

sample_hold.title: Sample & hold
sample_hold.desc: Captures the input value on a trigger edge and holds it until the next.

debounce.title: Debounce
debounce.desc: Ignores changes shorter than a stability window.

moving_average.title: Moving average
moving_average.desc: Average of the last N samples of a numeric signal.

median_filter.title: Median filter
median_filter.desc: Median of the last N samples — robust to outliers/spikes.

ramp.title: Ramp
ramp.desc: Moves from a start value toward a target at a fixed rate per second.

expression.title: Expression (custom script)
expression.desc: Compute outputs from inputs with a few lines of arithmetic — OUT1 = (IN1 + IN2) * IN3.

presence_mode.title: Presence → home mode
presence_mode.desc: Switches the home mode by presence: any sensor true → home, all silent for a delay → away. Bind the output to the Home device; never overrides manual modes (Night/Vacation).

climate_loop.title: Climate loop (EWMA → thermostat)
climate_loop.desc: Smooths a temperature with an EWMA filter, then drives a hysteresis thermostat — the canonical filter→controller composite.

irrigation_multizone.title: Multi-zone irrigation
irrigation_multizone.desc: Runs several irrigation zones on independent schedules from one shared rain/soil inhibit.

smoothed_sensor.title: Smoothed sensor
smoothed_sensor.desc: Rejects spikes with a median filter, then smooths with an EWMA — a clean signal from a noisy sensor.

cooling_relay.title: Cooling relay (hysteresis)
cooling_relay.desc: Generic cooling demand: turns on above the high threshold and off below the low, using the inverted hysteresis primitive.

smart_thermostat.title: Thermostat (from primitives)
smart_thermostat.desc: The classic thermostat rebuilt from primitives: EWMA smoothing → hysteresis relay. Bind heat to a boiler/valve.

stageHint.full: Trusted — its proposals are limited only by the safety floor
stageHint.bounded: Acts carefully — proposals clamped to baseline ± band
stageHint.shadow: Watching only — learns and records proposals, commands nothing

stageOption.shadow: Shadow — watches and learns, never acts
stageOption.bounded: Bounded — acts within a careful band
stageOption.full: Full — trusted up to the safety floor

promote.tooltip: Queue a Shadow → Bounded → Full promotion for approval (Epic 2C)
promote.title: Promote "{{name}}" {{from}} → {{to}}
promote.rationale: Review the backtest scorecard on /models before approving.
promote.queued: Queued a promotion proposal for "{{name}}". Approve it on the Proposals page.

status.runningHint: Ticking every 15 s — last run {{when}}, {{count}} ticks
status.idleHint: Enabled but hasn't produced output yet — check its input wiring
status.stalledHint: Enabled but hasn't ticked recently — the runtime may be down

baseline.label: Baseline setpoint
baseline.desc: Reference the model is nudged around (tracks the loop's live setpoint)

band.label: Band (±)
band.desc: How far the proposal may move from the baseline (Bounded stage)

driftThreshold.label: Drift threshold
driftThreshold.desc: Auto-demote to Shadow when the mean error exceeds this

driftWindowMin.label: Drift window (min)
driftWindowMin.desc: Rolling window used to measure drift

probThreshold.label: On threshold
probThreshold.desc: Probability at/above which the device is commanded on

boundedMargin.label: Bounded margin
boundedMargin.desc: Extra probability margin required to flip (hysteresis)

minDwellMin.label: Min dwell (min)
minDwellMin.desc: Minimum time to hold a state before flipping (anti-chatter)

maxClassStep.label: Max step
maxClassStep.desc: Max positions to move along the value order per change (Bounded stage)

hysteresis.label: Hysteresis (dead-band)
hysteresis.desc: Insensitivity zone around the setpoint so the relay doesn't chatter

coolSetpoint.label: Cooling target
coolSetpoint.desc: Upper target, used only in heat + cool mode

threshold.label: CO₂ threshold
threshold.desc: CO₂ level that calls for ventilation

runMinutes.label: Run time
runMinutes.desc: How long the valve stays open each cycle

offsetMinutes.label: Offset (min)
offsetMinutes.desc: Turn on this many minutes before sunset and off after sunrise

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.desc: Used when the threshold input is unbound

high.label: High threshold
high.desc: Turn ON above this (turn OFF above this when inverted)

low.label: Low threshold
low.desc: Turn OFF below this (turn ON below this when inverted)

epsilon.label: Change threshold (epsilon)
epsilon.desc: Minimum input change that passes through

setpoint.label: Setpoint
setpoint.desc: Target (used when the sp input is unbound)

ffGain.label: Feedforward gain
ffGain.desc: Weight of the ff disturbance input (0 = feedforward off)

outMin.label: Min output
outMin.desc: Lower limit of the output power

outMax.label: Max output
outMax.desc: Upper limit of the output power

tuneBand.label: Autotune noise band
tuneBand.desc: Band around the setpoint for the relay test (in process-value units)

delaySec.label: Delay
delaySec.desc: How long the input must stay true before the output turns on

delaySec.label: Delay
delaySec.desc: How long the output stays on after the input drops

widthSec.label: Run window
widthSec.desc: How long the output is on at the start of each cycle

stableSec.label: Stability window
stableSec.desc: How long a new value must hold before it passes

window.label: Window (samples)
window.desc: Number of recent samples to average

window.label: Window (samples)
window.desc: Number of recent samples in the median window

ratePerSec.label: Rate
ratePerSec.desc: Change per second toward the target

awayDelayMin.label: Away delay
awayDelayMin.desc: Silence across all sensors before switching to the away mode

hysteresis.high: Optional live upper threshold (overrides the param)
hysteresis.low: Optional live lower threshold (overrides the param)

interval.enable: Optional gate — false suppresses the pulse

presence_mode.current_mode: Current home mode (bind to the Home device) — the manual-mode guard

ml_thermostat.temperature: Measured (ideally filtered) signal — for the drift monitor

ml_switch.on_off: Measured on/off state — for the drift monitor

ml_selector.hvac_mode: Measured current value — for the drift monitor

invert.desc: Invert (on below low, off above high) — cooling-style
Emit true when OUT of range instead

priority.desc: Winner when set and reset are both true

preset.desc: Tuning profile — gentle (smooth, slow), balanced, responsive (fast, may overshoot), eco (energy-biased), manual (use kp/ki/kd), or autotune (run a relay experiment once, then track with the found gains)

script.desc: Expression program. Lines: `OUTn = expr` (output) or `name = expr` (local). Supports + - * / %, comparisons, && || !, a ? b : c, functions (min max abs clamp round floor ceil sqrt pow avg exp), and dt / prev(OUTn).

dialog.name: Name

dialog.stageDirect: Saving is your explicit approval of the stage; on drift the block auto-demotes back to Shadow
